Версия для Forge доступна **[здесь](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/revived-farmers-delight-crops-3d)**.

Также доступно на [**CurseForge**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/revived-farmers-delight-crops-3d-for-fabric)

Это версия для Fabric для [**REVIVED Farmer's Delight crops 3D**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/revived-farmers-delight-crops-3d).

Этот ресурспак предоставляет 3D-модели культур для следующих модов:
- **[Farmer's Delight Refabricated](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated)**
- **[Nether's Delight Refabricated](https://modrinth.com/mod/nethers-delight-refabricated)**
- **[My Nether's Delight Refabricated](https://modrinth.com/mod/my-nethers-delight-refabricated)**
- **[Farmer's Respite (Fabric)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/farmers-respite-fabric)** (CurseForge)
- **[Corn Delight \[Fabric/Quilt\]](https://modrinth.com/mod/corn-delight-fabric)**

Предложения и отчёты доступны через [**форму**](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScfSBV6_frlwlOsyyyIfXpRptl2VmqYNKy99Gl55r4tPGPtmw/viewform?usp=sf_link) и в [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/uTDu7K3Ezn)
